A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Unit out of 
 service.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor

Disconnect 
 electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be 
 isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves

Be sure pump must 
 be completely
 drained

Complete 
 maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid, 
 manual puller, Rages

Feeler gauge & 
 dial indicator

Disassembly of the pump for maintenance, 
 repair, or replacement should be done to the point required for the service 
 desired.

Drain system prior to any disassembly . 
 complete drainage is not required drain only to level necessary to prevent 
 leakage when disassembled . remove pipe plug # 31 B to drain pump .

Remove seal ( 9 
 - ) inch circulating line with or without filter furnished by other than 
 buffalo pump div. inspect line connection openings and filter if furnished for 
 any possible clogging or build up or deposits which may have occurred prior to 
 reassembly .

Remove combination casing cover and suction 
 elbow ( 5 ) by removing bolts and cap screws (102) care must be taken not to 
 damage casing cover ring (10) when removing .

Remove tru-arc snap ring (83) impeller lock nut 
 (15) and lock washer .

Remove impeler (3) the 5/16 balance holes 
 have been tapped for an impeler puller Use plate type puller bearing an 
 shaft extension .
Removal of cartridge seal from shaft .

Remove cap screws (102C) and remove shaft (7) 
 using Jack Screws .

Remove adaptor (60) this completes pump 
 disassembly .

Refer repair replacement instructions prior 
 to reassembly .

Refill system and check for leaks before 
 operating

Clean all parts thoroughly and check for burrs 
 and damage before assembly .

Install throat bushing with seal (11A) in 
 adopter (60) with sealing ring pin (136) locking plates (131) and machine 
 screws (156) after tightening machine screws bend tab of locking plates 
 against screw heads .

Install g- inch diameter asbestos gasket (65C) 
 on adopter (60) face , using graphite and oil on one side and shellac on the 
 back . Assemble adopter (60) to mounting face of turbine accessory gear casing 
 .

Coat stub end of pump shaft (17) with a thin 
 coat of clean white lead and mount shaft in gear shaft socket with cap screws 
 (102C ) tighten screws evenly

Check pump shaft for excessvnout and proper 
 clearance maximum all an able radial shaft run out at mechanical seal location 
 in 0.005 inch .

After shaft alignment and clearance have been 
 set lock cap screws (102C) un place by up setting surrounding metal with a 
 prick punch .

Coat outside diameter of casing wearing ring 
 (9) with thin coat of clean with thin coat of clean white lead and oil .

Install john crane mechanical seal (82) this 
 seal is designed to be installed as a complete package unit and must not be 
 disassembled prior to assembly into pump .

Assemble impeller (3) to shaft unit lock washer 
 (16) & lock nut (15) lock impeller assembly in place with truarc ring (83)

Coat out side diameter of casing cover ring 
 (10) with this coat of clean white lead and tap ring into bone of casing cover 
 (5) be sure ring seated firmly and squarely .

Inst all gasket (65A) 11 O.D. on 3 pump and 
 11-3/4 O.D. on 5 pumps on casing cover (5) in the same manner as step above 
 . Assemble casing cover (5) to casing (2) with cap screws (102) .

Install air cock (67) and pipe plugs (31B , 74 
 and 74A ) .

Seal circulating line , with or without filter 
 furnished by other than buffalo pump div., must be installed before operation 
 .
This completes the assembly of the pump.
Check shaft clearance as in step 4 above
